build.buildCommand: if [ -d backend ]; then cd backend; fi && pip install -r requirements.txt -c constraints.txt && pip uninstall -y opencv-python opencv-contrib-python && pip install --force-reinstall --no-deps opencv-python-headless==4.13.0.92

deploy.startCommand: if [ -d backend ]; then cd backend; fi && uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port $PORT
